card.name: Clinical terms awaiting a medical noun
card.fires_on: Fires on words or word parts in the middle of clinical phrases, where a medical term is still being completed or is about to follow. Examples are 'function tests', 'serum level', 'diabetes mell' and 'severity of many'.

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Partway through a drug name or disease name, or at a closing bracket after an abbreviation.

modes.label: Lab and monitoring phrases
modes.description: The noun or plural ending in phrases about tests and levels.
modes.example: Liver function<< tests>> should also be monitored prior to each course

modes.label: Linking words before disease terms
modes.description: Small words such as 'of', 'many' or 'resulting' that lead into a condition or adverse effect.
modes.example: may exacerbate the severity<< of>> many viral infections of the eye

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing with clinical medical wording and away from non-English tokens and generic words.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a medical phrase, where the next word will be another clinical term.
